sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, travel to Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. Sandbach have won 7 of their 10 matches so far despite suffering a loss in their most recent outing, and will be favourites against bottom-placed Alsager, who have managed just one win all season and are winless in their last five games.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town host struggling Dawley Town on Saturday, looking to close the gap on leaders Sandbach after their own recent loss. AFC Bridgnorth, third and just three points behind Sandbach, face a tough assignment at home to Eccleshall, who have won their last two games and sit in fifth. Wolverhampton Casuals, level on 19 points with AFC Bridgnorth, host bottom-dwellers Widnes Town (winless in five and conceding heavily) in what should be a comfortable fixture. Bilston Town, sixth on 17 points and on a three-game winning streak, visit Foley Meir in a mid-table encounter. The chasing pack continues with Barnton hosting Shawbury United—both seeking momentum in mid-table—while Crewe welcome Allscott Heath in a fixture between struggling sides. Market Drayton Town travel to in-form Cheadle Heath Nomads, though both teams remain in lower mid-table. New Mills, mid-table on 14 points, host Market Drayton Town in their Saturday fixture. Brereton Social, on poor recent form with three losses in their last six, face Widnes Town at home before a quick turnaround to visit Wednesfield Community on Wednesday evening; Wednesfield have recovered to win their last two games after a difficult spell and will fancy their chances in the midweek fixture.
